summary: Iteration 3 (gamified Rapid Fire, new tab order, /live route, auto-advance, public cards API). Backend: 23/23 pytest pass (9 new in test_rf_gamify.py + 14 regression). GET /api/rf/cards total=4100, 50/page, 82 pages, subject/chapter filters, paging and validation all work. /rf/profile, /rf/leaderboard, the solo complete reward (idempotent, no double XP) and the duel reward (only after finish, idempotent) all work. Frontend at 375x667: the tab order is Home, JEE Main, raised diamond RAPID, My Tests, Mission. tab-jee shows the JEE Main exam hub. home-tile-live opens /live (series-hub) and header-back-button returns. Every Rapid home element is present: game-hud, streak card, subjects, horizontal chapter chips, all 4 game modes, join code, the 9-badge trophy cabinet and the leaderboard. In a solo session, picking an option auto-advances in about 1 s. 'COMBO x2' shows after 2 correct answers and resets after a wrong one. Exit -> Finish shows the reward panel (+30 XP, +6 coins, 1-day streak, First Sprint badge), which matches the API. The invite + join duel works across two browser contexts and auto-advances in about 0.75 s. After B left (duel-exit-confirm), A got duel-result with duel-reward. Two bugs found: (1) a player who FORFEITS can WIN the duel on the time tie-break; (2) the Rapid home HUD, streak and history are stale when you return from a session. The test player auto-advance was NOT tested live because there are 0 in-progress attempts (code reviewed only). No deprecated Expo packages detected.

critical.issue: Forfeit is ignored when choosing the winner. Reproduced live: A stayed and played all 30 cards (0 correct, 29.9 s total), B answered 1 card and then left (forfeit=True, 1.36 s). Both scored 0, so the time tie-break made B, the player who left, the winner (tie_break=True). The player who stayed saw 'Good fight!'. A forfeiter with a higher score also wins. Reference: /app/backend/duels.py:59-72

minor.issue: The public API returns the 'answer' key for every card by id. The duel payload hides answers but still includes card ids, so a player can look up live duel answers (the test test_forfeit_player_cannot_win does exactly this). Consider leaving answers out by default or guarding them, or hiding card ids before the duel is revealed.

Race window: the award marker is inserted before the reward is stored, so a concurrent replay during the first award returns reward {}. The profile is also written read-modify-write with a whole-doc $set, so a solo session and a duel finishing at the same time can lose XP or coins. Use $inc and $addToSet. Reference: /app/backend/gamify.py:51-83

Duel rewards and the wins/duels counters are only granted when a player GETs the finished duel. A player who never reopens it (for example the forfeiter, TEST_B profile = 0 XP) never gets XP, wins or badges. Consider awarding both players inside settle().

ui_bugs.component: Rapid home HUD, streak and history (stale cache)
ui_bugs.issue: After finishing a solo session (+30 XP) and returning to the Rapid tab, game-hud still showed 'Level 1 · 0 / 100 XP · 0 coins · 0 streak'. The API already had xp=30. A full reload shows the right values. useCached only fetches on mount or key change; there is no refetch on focus. Reference: /app/frontend/src/components/game.tsx:15, /app/frontend/app/(tabs)/rapid.tsx

integration_issues.issue: The opponent who stays sees 'Good fight!' (a loss) when the leaver wins the time tie-break. The backend root cause is above.

issues: Auto-advance also fires when you change an already-answered question to a different option (only the tapped option's selected state is checked, at attempt/[id].tsx:177). This can feel jumpy when correcting an answer. Consider advancing only when the question was previously unanswered.

react_native_issues.issue: Still imported from 'expo-router/unstable-native-tabs' (flagged in iteration 2). Reference: /app/frontend/app/(tabs)/_layout.tsx:4

action_items: HIGH: In duels.py winner(), treat forfeit as a loss: if exactly one player has forfeit=True, the other player wins regardless of score or ms. Also review tie_break() so a leaver's small ms can never win.
Refetch the rf profile, history and leaderboard when the Rapid tab regains focus (useFocusEffect -> refresh in useCached) so the HUD, streak and badges update after a session or duel.
Make award() atomic: store the reward in the same insert or poll until it exists on DuplicateKey, and update the profile with $inc/$max/$addToSet instead of a whole-doc $set.
Consider awarding duel rewards to both players at settle time, not lazily on GET.
Consider leaving 'answer' out of the public /api/rf/cards response, or not exposing duel card ids before the reveal, to prevent duel cheating.
Change the NativeTabs import to the stable expo-router native-tabs path.
critical_code_review_comments: gamify.py:51-55 an empty reward {} can be returned to concurrent replays.
gamify.py:79 the whole-profile $set loses updates when awards run at the same time.

The duel create/join payload 'name' overwrites the leaderboard name on every duel (duels.py:45). The regression test used 'TEST_A'/'TEST_B' on real users and polluted leaderboard names. The test is fixed and the names are reset.

Read correct answers from the POST /api/rf/sessions response. CountUp animates reward numbers, so wait about 2 s before reading reward-xp. Create a duel second user with browser.new_context().
rca_of_issue: Forfeit win: forfeit() sets done=True and forfeit=True. settle() then calls winner(), which compares score and then total ms only. The leaver stops accumulating ms, so on equal scores the leaver always wins. Fix: check forfeit flags first in winner().
